output.description: Runs `git reset --hard` and `git clean` in a CI runner's checkout so the next job starts from a clean tree. First, any test-reports folder is moved out of the workspace into a timestamped archive directory for that runner. All other untracked files, uncommitted changes, and (if requested) ignored build outputs are permanently deleted.
output.declaring_phrase: any test-reports folder is moved out of the workspace into a timestamped archive directory
